sourceBasis.currentGuideVerification: Icy Veins / Wowhead Patch 12.1 Mythic+ guides checked 2026-09-14
sourceBasis.policy: SimulationCraft is authoritative for spell identity/mechanics where present. Current 12.1 guides are used to repair spec-availability gaps caused by spellId deduplication and to include utility not emitted by the selected spell_query sources.

scoringPolicy.duplicateRule: Use capability.stacking. Persistent unique effects never double count; rotational defensives/control generally diminish rather than become zero.
scoringPolicy.talentRule: Optional/choice/hero/pet capabilities should receive an availability discount at scoring time rather than being treated as guaranteed.
scoringPolicy.dungeonRule: Context-sensitive capability value must later be multiplied by the selected dungeon's relevance matrix.
